_metadata.description: Demand analytics with capacity metrics for dashboard consumption

query_parameters.dateFrom: Optional; ISO 8601 date format (yyyy-MM-dd); defaults to 30 days before dateTo
query_parameters.dateTo: Optional; ISO 8601 date format (yyyy-MM-dd); defaults to today
query_parameters.businessUnit: Optional; filters demands by business unit code

indexes_applied: idx_demands_filter: (status, priority, business_unit, account_name, location, employment_type, is_deleted) - existing
idx_demands_project_client: (project_id, account_id) - recommended for capacity grouping
idx_demands_business_unit_created: (business_unit, created_at) - composite for date+BU filtering

example_1_basic.description: Basic request with default date range (last 30 days)

example_2_with_dates.description: Request with explicit date range and business unit filter

sample_response_with_bu_filter.description: Response when filtering by Business Unit 'Engineering'

fillRate.description: Percentage of filled demands relative to total non-cancelled demands
fillRate.numerator: Count of demands with status in (FILLED_INTERNAL, FILLED_EXTERNAL, FILLED_PARTIALLY). Determined by first transition to FILLED_* in demand_status_history.
fillRate.denominator: Count of demands with status NOT IN (CANCELLED, DUPLICATE, ON_HOLD). Includes DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, INTERNAL_SEARCH, OPEN_EXTERNAL, FILLED_*, CLOSED.

avgTimeToFillDays.description: Average number of days from demand creation to first FILLED_* status transition
avgTimeToFillDays.numerator: Sum of (changed_at - created_at) in seconds for first FILLED_* transition, divided by 86400 to convert to days
avgTimeToFillDays.calculation_method: Uses demand_status_history table; identifies first transition to any FILLED_* status (FILLED_INTERNAL, FILLED_EXTERNAL, FILLED_PARTIALLY)
avgTimeToFillDays.zero_denominator_handling: Returns 0.0 if no filled demands exist in the window

internalVsExternalSplit.description: Count and percentage breakdown of filled demands by closure reason (internal vs external)
internalVsExternalSplit.filledInternal: Count of demands where status IN (FILLED_INTERNAL, FILLED_PARTIALLY, CLOSED) AND closure_reason = 'FILLED_INTERNAL'
internalVsExternalSplit.filledExternal: Count of demands where status IN (FILLED_EXTERNAL, FILLED_PARTIALLY, CLOSED) AND closure_reason = 'FILLED_EXTERNAL'
internalVsExternalSplit.percentages: Calculated as (count / (filledInternal + filledExternal)) * 100 for each; returns 0.0 if denominator is 0

capacityByProjectClient.description: Demand count grouped by project ID and client (account) ID for capacity planning
capacityByProjectClient.ordering: Results ordered by project_id ASC, account_id ASC
capacityByProjectClient.includes: All non-deleted demands matching date and businessUnit filters
capacityByProjectClient.use_case: Capacity reporting - shows which projects/clients have open demands and how many

date_range.description: Filters based on demand creation date (created_at)
date_range.logic: CAST(d.created_at AS DATE) >= CAST(:dateFrom AS DATE) AND CAST(d.created_at AS DATE) <= CAST(:dateTo AS DATE)
date_range.default_if_not_provided: dateFrom defaults to 30 days before dateTo; dateTo defaults to TODAY()

business_unit.description: Optional filter by business unit code
business_unit.default_if_not_provided: No filtering; includes all business units

cancelled_duplicates.description: Excluded from fillRate denominator (totalDemands count) but included in numerator if applicable
cancelled_duplicates.logic: status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'DUPLICATE') for non-cancelled count
cancelled_duplicates.rationale: Analytics should reflect active demand pipeline

http_status_codes.400: Bad Request - invalid date format (must be yyyy-MM-dd) or other parameter validation failure
http_status_codes.401: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token
http_status_codes.403: Forbidden - JWT token valid but user lacks ANALYTICS_DEMAND_VIEW authority
http_status_codes.500: Internal Server Error - database query or processing error

implementation_notes.no_pii_in_response: Response contains only aggregated counts, IDs, and calculated metrics. No user names, emails, or other PII is included.
implementation_notes.single_query_per_metric: Each metric is computed using a single native SQL aggregate query (no in-memory processing of full demand lists)
implementation_notes.read_only: Endpoint is read-only; no modifications to demands made
implementation_notes.caching: Consider caching metrics if business unit has > 10k demands and query approaches 500ms target
implementation_notes.indexing: Existing indexes in idx_demands_filter cover status and business_unit. Consider composite index on (business_unit, created_at) and separate index on closure_reason for optimal performance
